expectedRealization.rationale: Memory contract-price changes can reprice earnings expectations within one quarter, while inventory, wafer allocation and customer pass-through make full earnings conversion multi-quarter.

changeHypothesis.summary: Q1 2026 memory tightness accelerated sharply as server/HBM allocation constrained conventional DRAM/NAND. The industry signal is strong; among non-STAR A shares, 兆易创新 showed much stronger realized earnings and memory-segment conversion than 北京君正, but exact price-relative expectation burden remains unresolved.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: TrendForce repeatedly raised Q1/Q2 price expectations and company disclosures at the cutoff described tight DRAM supply and rising memory economics.
disconfirmingEvidence: The price-upcycle was already a prominent narrative by late Q1.
Fabless suppliers can be volume-constrained even when ASP rises.
Exact consensus/valuation burden at the cutoff is not frozen.

causalChain.mechanism: Capacity allocation toward HBM/server memory reduces flexible supply for conventional DRAM/NAND.
causalChain.failureMode: Capacity returns faster than expected or end demand weakens.

causalChain.mechanism: Higher ASP/mix can lift revenue and gross margin if a supplier has inventory/wafer access and can pass pricing through.
causalChain.failureMode: Wafer scarcity caps shipments or input-price increases absorb ASP gains.

causalChain.mechanism: A selected supplier must convert the cycle better than peers and exceed already-elevated expectations.
causalChain.failureMode: The cycle is fully discounted or the control has greater incremental sensitivity.

directWinners: fabless memory suppliers with secured wafer allocation and pricing power
secondOrderWinners: memory module/channel firms with favorable inventory
losers: OEMs exposed to higher memory BOM
falseThemeMatches: semiconductor names without material memory exposure

aShareCandidates.name: 兆易创新
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: 2025 memory-chip revenue RMB 6.566bn, +26.41%, with memory gross margin 42.84%; company-wide net profit +49.47%.

earningsSensitivity.base: Memory up-cycle already improved 2025 price/volume and margin.
earningsSensitivity.favorable: Q1/Q2 contract-price increases convert into further ASP/margin upside.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: Wafer allocation tightness or already-high expectations cap incremental upside.

aShareCandidates.name: 北京君正
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Company describes automotive/industrial DRAM exposure, tight 2026 supply and expected price/margin improvement; 2025 profit growth was modest.

earningsSensitivity.favorable: 2026 DRAM pricing and margin improve while inventory and allocations support shipment growth.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: Supply constraints prevent volume growth or cost pass-through dilutes margin.

matchedControls.name: 北京君正
matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: Direct automotive/industrial DRAM exposure with the same Q1 memory-cycle tailwind.
matchedControls.whySelectedCompanyShouldOutperform: 兆易创新 entered the cutoff with materially stronger realized memory revenue, margin and company-wide profit conversion, whereas 北京君正 still depended more heavily on 2026 forward improvement.

selectedAdvantages: 2025 memory revenue and gross margin already accelerating
selectedDisadvantages: 北京君正 may have greater incremental upside if 2026 DRAM pricing flows through from a lower earnings base
exact cutoff valuation comparison is not frozen
pairwise.switchCondition: Prefer 北京君正 if its wafer allocation and quarterly price pass-through produce clearly faster earnings revisions while 兆易创新's valuation already discounts the memory up-cycle.

selectionComparison.rationale: 兆易创新 has the stronger verified current earnings bridge, but the price-relative edge cannot be called clear without a frozen valuation/consensus baseline.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The memory shortage and price-upcycle were already visible by late Q1 and both companies discussed it publicly.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Tightness persists into Q2 and raises earnings, with 兆易创新 showing the cleaner already-realized bridge.
expectations.measurableGap: Fundamental direction is supported; the remaining unknown is how much of that direction was already embedded in each stock price.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward earnings/segment-growth burden versus a direct memory peer; no fixed PE threshold.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: Late-Q1 public information already described a strong memory up-cycle, so simply forecasting higher ASP is not an expectation gap.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: 兆易创新 sustains memory price/volume growth and margin expansion enough to produce revisions beyond the already-known cycle.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Incremental memory earnings must outpace 北京君正 after adjusting for the amount of cycle improvement already visible in 2025 results and priced by the market.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Memory fundamentals improve as expected but both stocks merely deliver the already-known cycle, leaving no selection alpha.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: Exact point-in-time valuation/consensus was not frozen in the evidence pack, so this cannot be High-priority.
valuationExecution.alreadyPricedAssessment: industry opportunity strong; stock-selection burden unresolved.

bearCase: The memory cycle is real but already priced, or the more supply-constrained 北京君正 produces greater incremental earnings torque from a lower base.

invalidationConditions.threshold: clear reversal or normalization inconsistent with the Q2 persistence thesis

invalidationConditions.indicator: 兆易创新 relative earnings conversion
invalidationConditions.observationMethod: next reporting cycle versus 北京君正
invalidationConditions.threshold: no superior revenue/margin/earnings revision despite the stronger starting bridge
